Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function tanh() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultTanH  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).tanh (); // creates a UnaryTanHUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultTanH  =  tanh(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryTanHUGen
See also:
